title: Research: later-source compact repair with inactive saturated digits
body:
The unchanged later-source compact-control word can safely retain saturated dirty temporary digits at inactive positions, provided their compact carry cannot reach either subcall's active positions. This adds an all-n sufficient invariant guard and exact two-state density formula. At n=2,K=6,G=2, the complete-rectangle safe fraction grows from PR1247's 1971/4096 to 9085/16384. For n=1 only, the guard is proved maximal among invariant full-map agreement sets.

Only `research/compact-late-carry-guard/` is added. The package contains the self-contained proof, a separately implemented quotient verifier, immutable source/document pins, a deterministic receipt, semantic failure controls, a replay hook, task/selection metadata, and open next questions. The guard preserves the complete dirty map and supports the retained current-address correction `T S^-1`; all twelve swaps, ten rotations, highest-bit completion and full payload/descriptor repair costs remain charged.

Validation on macOS arm64:
- Python 3.12.14 registered replay and Python 3.14.7 optimized isolated minimal read-only relocation passed.
- All 598,592 quotient states, 73,600 digit-transition cases, 544 physical interpreter comparisons, and 5,824 sorted repair payloads passed. The wrong-key control fills every hole but misplaces 5,024 payloads and rejects.
- Seven named mathematical controls and nine source/algorithm/receipt corruption controls passed under optimization.
- All 17 existing compact-control tests, selected-record integrity, package metadata/source pins, and staged whitespace checks passed.

Started from current main `1f327c6f3e3a35271c5c141d381b540bab8ad005`; the repository-selected adversarial `uniform-transfer-audit` card was refined to the quantified exceptional-repair implication (nonce `b0d948f61caf27df25160f9b811ecba6`). [Claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1588). Final overlap at 03:46 UTC covered 729 open PRs including drafts and 242 discussion/comment/reply records, with complete pagination and no warnings; no matching later-source inactive-saturation contribution appeared. These text searches do not establish novelty across every code diff.

Credit Hanson Sun / @bbMisk's PR1247 (`392316a45197ef213cff4febd24aa7fd5e16237f`) for the nonsaturated later-source guard and correlated density, Sagar Thakrar's PR1475 (`0bca9e7b4e4c9843ceaa99bdda6ccc047d503ac9`) for earlier-source saturation and its open later-source question, Douglas Colkitt's retained word/interpreter/repair interface, PR763/1219/1108 and OpenAI's original framework. No pending audit implementation is imported. Prepared for Arham Tahir with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0; one agent and no independent human review claim.

No new kappa, production predicate change, selected-frontier change or measured speedup is claimed. Maximality for n>1 and internal source-load/cancellation cases remain open. Full selected cold replay, physical/tape/compiler/recursive hosting, precision, analytic transfer, the multiplication theorem, Linux/hosted CI and proof-assistant verification are outside the executed scope.
